title: Pilot Study of a Combination Drug Product for Treatment of Short-term Insomnia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effect of a combination drug product containing diphenhydramine, zolpidem and lorazepam on total sleep time. Participants will be adults who sometimes have difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep, but who do not have chronic insomnia. The study involves 3 one-night stays in a sleep center in New York City.
